bio.text: Troy Dale Jackson is the Democratic candidate for U.S. Senate in Maine in the November 3, 2026 general election, after advancing from the Democratic convention on July 25, 2026.
He served in the Maine House of Representatives from 2002 to 2008 and in the Maine State Senate, representing District 35 from 2008 to 2014 and District 1 from 2016 to December 2024.
He holds an associate degree from the University of Maine at Fort Kent, and his professional experience includes working as a self-employed logger.
